sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing, so an entire chain of meaningful computations collapses to Nothing if any single step fails.
sketches.resonance: One unanswered moment annihilates every beautiful thing that followed — the bind operator knows how loss propagates.
sketches.draft:
together :: Maybe a
together = return () >>= \_ ->
           Just () >>= \_ ->
           Just () >>= \_ ->
           Nothing >>= \_ ->
           Just () >>= \_ ->
           Just ()

sketches.mechanism: A generator function that yields once and then returns — the caller can only call next() one more time before StopIteration is raised permanently.
sketches.resonance: Some things can only be given once; asking again is not silence but an error.
sketches.draft:
def trust():
    yield True

g = trust()
next(g)
next(g)

sketches.mechanism: The lateinit keyword declares a variable that must be initialized before use, but accessing it before initialization throws UninitializedPropertyAccessException at runtime.
sketches.resonance: We declared space for something we were never ready to fill — and the moment we reached for it, everything broke.
